card.name: Bedhaya
card.era: Modern form traditionally dated to Sultan Agung of Mataram (r. 1613-1645)
card.tagline: Sacred Javanese court dance of refined alus character
card.profile: The bedhaya is a sacred, ritualized Javanese court dance associated with the royal palaces of Yogyakarta and Surakarta (Wikipedia). Along with the srimpi, it epitomized the elegant (alus) character of the royal court and became an important symbol of the ruler's power. It is performed by nine female dancers, relatives or wives of the Susuhunan, before a private audience. The modern form is traditionally dated to the court of Sultan Agung of Mataram, though it was not clearly documented until the late 18th century. Origin myths involve either a Hindu deity creating the nine dancers or Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, Goddess of the Southern Sea.
card.insight: The bedhaya takes distinct forms in each court city - the Bedhaya Ketawang of Surakarta and the Bedhaya Semang of Yogyakarta, the latter unperformed for over two decades (Wikipedia).

observation.setting: Traditional wooden Indonesian hall with carved pillars, decorated with scattered flower petals on the floor
observation.formation_and_space: Group starts kneeling in lines facing away, then rises to travel in coordinated lines and formations across the stage
observation.posture: Upright erect torso when standing, lower back arched; bent knees in low stances and kneeling positions
observation.footwork: Gliding steps, small weight shifts, and low kneeling or squatting transitions in sync with the beat; precise foot placement obscured by long skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: Fluid expressive arm gestures, graceful wrist rolls, and long sashes draped over arms being manipulated during turns and poses
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle torso sways, graceful tilts, and controlled upper body movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between kneeling on the floor, low squats, and standing levels; graceful turns without jumps
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional Javanese attire including batik patterned lower garments, dark strapless tops with gold ornamentation, ornate golden headpieces with floral elements, arm cuffs, and shoulder sashes
observation.cannot_infer: Precise footwork details and exact weight transfer are obscured by long floor-length skirts and camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers kneeling in unison facing backward with heads bowed to the floor, slowly rising their arms outward.
Dancers standing in a horizontal line, facing forward with arms held low at the sides, executing gentle swaying hand gestures.
Dancers moving in a staggered group formation while manipulating sashes on their arms with controlled upper body postures.
Dancers in low stances moving gracefully around wooden pillars with synchronized arm and hand movements.
